texte.Un cadre de gouvernance sans porteurs id: A governance framework without identified owners remains a dead document — here, it becomes operational.
texte.Un cas comparable arrêté en production v: A comparable case halted in production is worth more, for a decision, than ten successes published by their authors.
texte.Un cas d’usage classé haut risque change: A use case classified as high-risk changes its cost and its timetable: discovering this after the PoC costs you the PoC.
texte.Un cas d’usage retenu doit ensuite passe: A shortlisted use case must then go through the AI Act simulator: its risk class determines the real cost of the project. A promising case classified as high-risk is not disqualified, but its budget must include compliance.
texte.Un cas d’usage à fort retour dans une or: A high-return use case in an immature organisation is not delivered any faster — it fails faster.
texte.Un cas d’usage à fort retour et à fort r: A high-return, high-risk use case is not to be discarded: it is to be sequenced differently.
texte.Un certificat # ne vous fait sortir d’au: A # certificate does not take you out of any obligation: qualification is calculated on sector and size, not on your posture.
texte.Un certificat non migré cesse d’être val: A certificate that has not been migrated ceases to be valid at the end of the transition period, whatever the expiry date printed on it. Your certification body knows this date for your certificate.
texte.Un chiffrage assis sur une déclaration q: A costing based on a declaration that someone signs, rather than on a market average. It is the costliest half of the exercise, and it also serves the footprint.
texte.Un chiffrage n’est pas un devis: A costing is not a quote
texte.Un chiffrage produit par un modèle et re: A costing produced by a model and included in a proposal commits the company. The traceability of the calculation is not a convenience: it is the document in the dispute.
texte.Un chiffre lu à l’écran ne sert à rien :: A figure read on screen serves no purpose: it ends up in an investment memo, a credit file, a technical statement in response to a call for tenders. As long as it has to be copied by hand, it loses along the way what gives it its value — its nature, its source, its edition, and what the module refuses to decide. Four files can therefore be downloaded in WORD AND PDF. Three are available at any time, under the “Envelope & DPGF” tab: the PROSPECTS, the SITING REFERENCE FRAMEWORK country by country, and the ESTATE of listed centres with its footprint. The fourth, the ENVELOPE AND THE DPGF, appears only AFTER a calculation, and that is intentional: it exports THAT calculation, with the parameters you have just chosen, never default values that nobody would have decided. A fifth button brings the four together. Each document carries, on its first page, the VERSION of every reference framework used — because a printed file loses its metadata, but must not lose with it the means of being replayed, and therefore contested. It also carries the nature of each value, its sources, the items left EMPTY with the question to ask, and the reservations that qualify the figures. Finally, these documents do NOT carry the marking of Article #, and say so in plain words: no language model is involved in drafting them; they are composed by deterministic calculation. Applying this marking everywhere would amount to no longer signalling anything where it really matters.
texte.Un chiffre qu’on ne sait plus reconstitu: A figure you can no longer reconstruct cannot be defended. That is what this page keeps: less the result than the path that leads to it.
texte.Un chiffre repris d’un référentiel sans: A figure taken from a reference framework without recalculation on your scope does not pass a verifier’s first question: “where does it come from?”
texte.Un chiffre unique se conteste, une fourc: A single figure gets contested; a range gets discussed. Carry the assumptions with the amount, otherwise it is the amount alone that will be remembered — and used against you.
texte.Un classement des pays selon SEPT critèr: A ranking of countries against SEVEN criteria weighted by you: carbon intensity, dispatchability of the mix, water, free cooling, price, estate in service, connection queue.
texte.Un comité sans décisions réservées et sa: A committee without reserved decisions and without written reasons is not governance: it is a meeting.
texte.Un comité sans décisions réservées ne go: A committee without reserved decisions does not govern: it informs.
texte.Un commentaire généré est aussi affirmat: A generated comment is just as assertive when it is wrong. A reviewer who relies on it reads the same error twice: in the intent and in the code, without ever comparing them.
texte.Un coût calculé sur trois systèmes décla: A cost calculated on three declared systems out of twelve is not a budget, it is a sample. Address coverage before deciding.
texte.Un cycle d’audit interne et une revue de: An internal audit cycle and a management review must HAVE TAKEN PLACE before stage #. They leave dated traces: they cannot be fabricated the day before.
texte.Un dispositif conforme et inutilisé se d: A compliant framework that nobody uses degrades silently: nobody reports what nobody opens.
texte.Un dispositif qui survit au départ de la: A framework that survives the departure of the person who set it up.
texte.Un dispositif unique tenu devant trois r: A single framework held against three reference frameworks, instead of three parallel frameworks that will diverge at the first revision.
texte.Un distributeur qui revend sous sa marqu: A distributor who resells under its own brand, or who makes a substantial modification, becomes a manufacturer — Article #, without transition and without warning.
texte.Un distributeur, importateur, déployeur: A distributor, importer, deployer or third party itself becomes a provider (with the obligations of Art. #) if it: (a) puts its name/trademark on a system already placed on the market; (b) makes a substantial modification to a high-risk system already deployed; (c) modifies the purpose of a system not classified as high-risk in such a way that it becomes high-risk.
texte.Un document qui porte ses propres réserv: A document that carries its own reservations — that is what makes it defensible, not what weakens it.
texte.Un document sans date de revue est présu: A document without a review date is presumed outdated. A policy from # never re-read weakens the file instead of supporting it.
texte.Un délai de raccordement qui n’est pas o: A connection lead time that is not enforceable against the grid operator is not a lead time: it is an intention.
texte.Un extrait mémorisé arrive sans son en-t: A memorised excerpt arrives without its header. On code of around thirty lines that resembles a known project, the question arises — and it arises before publication, not after.
texte.Un extrait qui ne se retrouve pas dans v: An excerpt that cannot be found in your text brings down the proposal
texte.Un filtre de premier niveau avant d’enga: A first-level filter before committing development resources to a risky project.
texte.Un humain compétent et formé pour cet ex: A competent human trained for this review
texte.Un importateur qui appose sa marque, ou: An importer who puts its brand on a product, or who makes a substantial modification, IS NO LONGER an importer: it is a manufacturer, with reporting within # h.
texte.Un indice de maturité et les axes de pro: A maturity index and areas for improvement.
texte.Un indice global élevé ne prédit PAS un: A high global index does NOT predict a successful audit: stage # is decided on a single document.
texte.Un modèle entraîné sur des décisions pas: A model trained on past decisions reproduces past refusals. Postcode, name, contract type: documenting the variables and their justification is the only defence.
A model first produces what works. A person writing code runs into edge cases along the way; a generation goes around them without ever meeting them, and the code looks complete.
texte.Un modèle produit un nom de paquet plaus: A model produces a plausible package name with the same confidence as a real one. Attackers publish these invented names, relying precisely on this regularity. A human reviewer never spontaneously checks that an import exists: they assume the author knew.
texte.Un modèle, ses données d’entraînement et: A model, its training data and its API are three distinct assets, with three different exposures.
texte.Un ordre de priorité qui tient devant un: An order of priority that holds up in front of a committee, because it rests neither on the amount alone nor on criticality alone.
texte.Un parc de systèmes proches se documente: An estate of similar systems is documented by family — reusing an existing file is worth more than ten files drafted separately.
texte.Un parcours pour la direction financière: A path for the finance department and the risk committee. It does NOT claim to estimate a compliance cost — neither person-days nor fees: these figures are neither in the text nor reliably public. It quantifies what the Regulation puts its own figures on: three tiers of fines, and the turnover threshold at which the percentage takes over from the fixed amount.
texte.Un pilier faible ne devient un risque qu: A weak pillar only becomes a risk when crossed with a critical use. It is the next step that makes this cross-check, not this one.
texte.Un plafond n’est pas une amende: A ceiling is not a fine
texte.Un plan de montée en compétence qui part: A skills development plan that starts from the gaps observed, instead of the catalogue everyone follows in the same order.
texte.Un plan d’action point par point, avec l: A point-by-point action plan, with the legal reference for each.
texte.Un plan qui promet # % partout se défait: A plan that promises # % everywhere falls apart at the first precise question. Setting out its limits yourself is what makes the rest credible.
texte.Un point de comparaison chiffré — un ord: A quantified point of comparison — an isolated order of magnitude says neither whether it is good nor whether it is bad.
texte.Un point de référence unique pour les éq: A single point of reference for technical AND compliance teams — without duplication, and therefore without divergence.
texte.Un point de référence unique, accessible: A single point of reference, accessible to data AND compliance teams without duplication.
texte.Un point d’accès unique pour toute perso: A single access point for anyone in the organisation looking for evidence or a reference framework.
texte.Un prestataire de services de confiance: A trust service provider notifies within # h, not #. If you are one, your first two deadlines merge.
texte.Un produit de classe II sans interventio: A class II product without the involvement of a notified body is non-compliant, whatever the quality of the file provided.
texte.Un périmètre écrit, opposable, et le mêm: A written, enforceable scope, and the same one as that of the financial costing — two inventories kept side by side would diverge within a month.
texte.Un rapport dont chaque chiffre porte sa: A report in which each figure carries its qualification, which an auditor will ask for before anything else.
texte.Un rapport dont les réserves sont écrite: A report whose reservations are written by you rather than discovered by the verifier.
texte.Un rapport qui résiste à la question « s: A report that withstands the question “on what scope?”, asked systematically.
texte.Un registre IA bien tenu nourrit directe: A well-kept AI register directly feeds your GDPR records of processing activities, without re-entry.
texte.Un relevé du même processus avant et apr: A reading of the same process before and after, on the same people and the same volume. The gain rate entered at step # of the mapping is a scoping assumption: reusing it here would turn an assumption into a finding.
texte.Un représentant établi dans l'UE doit êt: A representative established in the EU must be designated by written mandate before placing on the market or putting into service in the EU.
texte.Un risque OWASP traité ne vaut pas confo: A treated OWASP risk does not amount to compliance, and a fulfilled obligation does not amount to security.
texte.Un risque non chiffrable n’est pas un ri: A risk that cannot be quantified is not a zero risk: record it with the note “to be measured”, otherwise it will disappear from the file.
texte.Un référent polyvalent peut suffire au d: A multi-role lead may be enough at the start — provided their role is written, not assumed.
texte.Un référent polyvalent suffit au démarra: A multi-role lead is enough at the start — provided their role is WRITTEN. An assumed role disappears at the first departure.
texte.Un régime sévère ne vous concerne que si: A strict regime only concerns you if you deploy there, sell there or process data there. Cross-checking against your actual locations is work that still has to be done by hand.
texte.Un score ancien n’est pas un score faux: An old score is not a wrong score
texte.Un secteur en retard ne justifie pas de: A lagging sector does not justify lagging; a leading sector does not justify investing without a use case. The benchmark positions, it does not decide.
texte.Un seul produit de classe II impose un c: A single class II product imposes a notified-body timetable on the whole organisation. The estate average describes no real product.
texte.Un site non recensé ne pèse rien dans ce: An unlisted site weighs nothing in this total. The figure measures what has been counted, not what exists.
texte.Un support de comité qui dit ce qui est: A committee deck that says what is measured, what is calculated and what remains to be decided in the data room.
texte.Un support dont chaque chiffre est traça: A deck in which each figure can be traced back to the calculation that produced it.
texte.Un support d’arbitrage qui distingue ce: A decision deck that distinguishes what can be contracted, what can be insured and what leads you to walk away.
texte.Un support d’arbitrage qui tranche entre: A decision deck that decides between what can be covered, what can be contracted and what is to be refused.
texte.Un système absent du Registre n’apparaît: A system absent from the register appears nowhere on this matrix — and the empty quadrant then reads as good news.
texte.Un système absent du registre ne coûte r: A system absent from the register costs nothing and weighs nothing in the tables, which does not mean it has no effect.
texte.Un système absent du registre sera absen: A system absent from the register will be absent from the risk assessment, and therefore absent from the Statement of Applicability. The omission propagates.
texte.Un système en conception n’a pas de volu: A system in design has no volume because it consumes nothing. Nothing to follow up here.
texte.Un système est haut risque si : (#) comp: A system is high-risk if: (#) it is a safety component of a product subject to third-party conformity assessment (Annex I), or (#) it is a stand-alone system used in one of the # areas of Annex III.
texte.Un système présumé non conforme ne peut: A system presumed non-compliant cannot be placed on the market; where there is a risk, the provider and the market surveillance authorities are informed.
texte.Un tableau de bord de pilotage et les po: A steering dashboard and points of attention.
texte.Un taux de couverture bas n’est pas un r: A low coverage rate is not a reproach to the teams: it is a resource trade-off, and it is dealt with at your level.
texte.Un taux n'est PAS une conformité. Sur un: A rate is NOT compliance. On a legal obligation, an authority decides; on a certifiable standard, an accredited body; on a voluntary framework, nobody. Each card carries the sentence that says what # % does not mean, and it counts as much as the figure.
texte.Un taux n’est pas une conformité. Chaque: A rate is not compliance. Each card carries the sentence that says what # % does not mean, and it is that sentence you quote in committee, not the figure.
texte.Un tiret dans la colonne CRA n’est pas u: A dash in the CRA column is not a forgotten box: it means the Regulation says nothing about this module.
texte.Un tiret dans une colonne n’est pas un o: A dash in a column is not an oversight: it means the text says nothing about this module.
texte.Un usage déclaré n’est pas un usage obse: A declared use is not an observed use. The question to ask in a review is not “have you adopted it” but “show me the last time”.
texte.Un écart entre deux scénarios qui tient: A gap between two scenarios that falls within the uncertainty of the items is not a gap: look at the ranges before the totals.
texte.Un écart qui persiste après formation ne: A gap that persists after training is not corrected by one more course: it points to a tool poorly placed in the real work, or an access right that was never opened.
texte.Un écart « reprendre d'abord X dans #-#: A gap “first address X in #-#” is not scheduled on the OT side: it is a dependency, not a task.
texte.Un état des lieux structuré des principe: A structured review of the current state of the principles of Article #.
texte.Une AIPD est réalisée pour les traitemen: A DPIA is carried out for high-risk processing
texte.Une IA embarquée dans une machine de cha: AI embedded in a construction machine falls under Annex I of the AI Act via the Machinery Regulation. It is the most likely regulatory vehicle for this sector.
texte.Une IA intégrée à un équipement d'extrac: AI integrated into extraction equipment falls under Annex I of the AI Act via the Machinery Regulation: conformity assessment before placing on the market.
texte.Une TRAJECTOIRE au lieu d’un instantané: A TRAJECTORY instead of a snapshot — it is what an auditor asks for, and what an isolated score never shows.
